column1: # Psalms of Solomon: one row per verse of Swete (texts/orig/PsS.json "grc", the numbering this site uses). Columns: swete_cv; charles_cv, the verse of the English check text (texts/en/PsS.json "charles", G. Buchanan Gray's translation in R. H. Charles's Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha, vol. 2, 1913) whose text it holds (where it straddles, the verse it starts in; empty: that copy lacks it), aligned by reading the Greek against the English verse by verse (2026-11-12); remark; whole English verses that also stand inside this Swete verse; modern_cv, the verse number in Rahlfs's Septuaginta (1935), which NETS (Atkinson, 2007: "The present translation follows Rahlfs' numbering") also uses, found by aligning Swete's Greek word by word with the digital Rahlfs text of github.com/eliranwong/LXX-Rahlfs-1935 (from the CCAT LXX files), read 2026-11-12; a range means the Swete verse holds parts of more than one Rahlfs verse. The first four columns follow tools/4ma-numbers.tsv, so tools/works-texts.py can show the English in Swete numbering (its en_order); the fifth is for converting other books' references, which use the modern numbers.
